content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make chickpea and red bean salad, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase dried chickpeas from the bulk section (15 minutes)
Step 2. Clean the kitchen counter surfaces (5 minutes)
Step 3. Soak the dried chickpeas in cold water (12 hours)
Step 4. Rinse the soaked chickpeas thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 5. Dice the red bell peppers (10 minutes)
Step 6. Mince the fresh garlic cloves (3 minutes)
Step 7. Find the large stockpot in the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 8. Finely chop the red onions (8 minutes)
Step 9. Boil the chickpeas until tender (1 hour)
Step 10. Prepare a large mixing bowl (2 minutes)
Step 11. Drain the cooked chickpeas into a colander (1 minute)
Step 12. Slice the cherry tomatoes in half (5 minutes)
Step 13. Chop the fresh parsley (5 minutes)
Step 14. Wash all fresh vegetables under cold water (4 minutes)
Step 15. Measure out the extra virgin olive oil (1 minute)
Step 16. Check the pantry for red beans and spices (5 minutes)
Step 17. Locate the ground cumin (1 minute)
Step 18. Pick fresh herbs from the garden (10 minutes)
Step 19. Zest a fresh lemon (2 minutes)
Step 20. Retrieve the salad tongs from the drawer (30 seconds)
Step 21. Let the chickpeas cool to room temperature (30 minutes)
Step 22. Fill the stockpot with filtered water (2 minutes)
Step 23. Sort through chickpeas to remove small stones (5 minutes)
Step 24. Open the cans of red kidney beans (2 minutes)
Step 25. Drain and rinse the red kidney beans (3 minutes)
Step 26. Measure the dried oregano (30 seconds)
Step 27. Whisk the dressing ingredients in a small jar (2 minutes)
Step 28. Take the red beans out of the cupboard (1 minute)
Step 29. Pat the chickpeas dry with a paper towel (4 minutes)
Step 30. Locate the sea salt and black pepper (1 minute)
Step 31. Place the chickpeas in a temporary container (2 minutes)
Step 32. Peel the outer skin off the onions (2 minutes)
Step 33. Shake the dressing jar vigorously (1 minute)
Step 34. Dice the English cucumber (6 minutes)
Step 35. Sharpen the chef's knife (4 minutes)
Step 36. Find the can opener (30 seconds)
Step 37. Rinse the red beans once more (2 minutes)
Step 38. Squeeze the juice from the lemon (2 minutes)
Step 39. Wash the celery stalks (2 minutes)
Step 40. Thinly slice the celery (5 minutes)
Step 41. Sanitize the cutting board (3 minutes)
Step 42. Set out the measuring spoons (1 minute)
Step 43. Clean the colander for reuse (2 minutes)
Step 44. Combine chickpeas and red beans in the bowl (2 minutes)
Step 45. Add a pinch of salt to the mixture (30 seconds)
Step 46. Skim the foam off the boiling chickpeas (5 minutes)
Step 47. Grate a small amount of ginger (2 minutes)
Step 48. Add the chopped onions to the bowl (1 minute)
Step 49. Retrieve a fresh lemon from the fridge (30 seconds)
Step 50. Grate some fresh black pepper (1 minute)
Step 51. Wash the parsley bunch (2 minutes)
Step 52. Clear a space on the dining table (2 minutes)
Step 53. Chop the stalks of fresh cilantro (4 minutes)
Step 54. Crumble the feta cheese (3 minutes)
Step 55. Set the stove to high heat (1 minute)
Step 56. Buy a new jar of cumin if empty (20 minutes)
Step 57. Peel the cucumber (2 minutes)
Step 58. Taste the salad for seasoning (1 minute)
Step 59. Toss the legumes together (2 minutes)
Step 60. Wipe down the salad bowl (1 minute)
Step 61. Measure the apple cider vinegar (1 minute)
Step 62. Fetch the vegetable wash spray (1 minute)
Step 63. Pour the dressing over the salad (1 minute)
Step 64. Slice the scallions (3 minutes)
Step 65. Sterilize the knife (2 minutes)
Step 66. Remove seeds from the bell pepper (2 minutes)
Step 67. Prepare the vinaigrette base (3 minutes)
Step 68. Dice the remaining vegetables (10 minutes)
Step 69. Combine all chopped vegetables in the bowl (3 minutes)
Step 70. Prepare a side of pita bread (5 minutes)
Step 71. Wash the scallions (2 minutes)
Step 72. Add the cucumber to the mix (1 minute)
Step 73. Garnish with remaining herbs (2 minutes)
Step 74. De-seed the red pepper (2 minutes)
Step 75. Compost the vegetable scraps (3 minutes)
Step 76. Look for the red wine vinegar (2 minutes)
Step 77. Finely dice the shallots (4 minutes)
Step 78. Take the feta cheese out of the fridge (30 seconds)
Step 79. Mix all ingredients thoroughly (3 minutes)
Step 80. Serve the salad in chilled bowls (2 minutes)
